dependencies.title: AI and OCR privacy review checklist
AI and OCR usage cost controls
AI and OCR integration test plan

checks.requirement: Every enabled capability has one approved environment, provider, model, endpoint, adapter commit, bounded resilience policy, and secret reference that match the release deployment.
blockingConditions: an enabled capability has an unconfigured or mismatched provider adapter
a credential value is stored in source or evidence
the provider or model changed without renewed privacy, cost, and sandbox review

checks.requirement: Every enabled provider and capability has a current approved privacy decision covering minimization, retention, training, subprocessors, region, deletion, incident handling, and safe operational evidence.
requiredEvidence: provider terms or data-processing agreement reference
blockingConditions: any required privacy decision is fail or missing
provider retention, training, region, deletion, or incident terms are unknown
raw AI or OCR content can enter logs, events, dashboards, tickets, or release evidence

checks.requirement: The published privacy policy and capability-specific consent flow disclose external processing before transmission and provide withdrawal plus a non-provider path.
blockingConditions: provider processing can start before required consent
the privacy policy omits external AI or OCR processing
consent withdrawal does not stop future provider calls
withdrawal leaves no safe manual path

checks.requirement: Per-user limits, request-size limits, monthly budget thresholds, admin visibility, and an approved provider billing review match the release capability and environment.
requiredEvidence: access-controlled provider billing reconciliation owner and freshness
blockingConditions: a production budget or accountable owner is missing
configured limits exceed approved values
usage is not visible to the authenticated admin role
provider-billed spend cannot be reconciled
operational budget or billing amounts are copied into a public or broadly shared evidence channel

checks.requirement: Disabled, unavailable, rejected, low-confidence, and failed provider paths preserve manual draft entry or retry-later behavior without confirming a financial record.
requiredEvidence: retry-later and provider-disabled user experience result
blockingConditions: a provider failure can confirm or partially persist an authoritative financial record
the user loses access to manual draft entry
retry can duplicate a draft or external request without an idempotency guard
the user-facing error exposes provider details or sensitive content

checks.requirement: All required FIN-123 cases pass on the release commit and every enabled provider and model has a current approved sandbox contract result.
blockingConditions: a required test is failed, skipped, quarantined, or stale
an enabled provider and model lacks a matching sandbox contract result
test or support evidence contains real or provider-captured user data
provider output bypasses deterministic validation or user confirmation

checks.requirement: Authenticated operators can observe safe request, rejection, latency, failure, quota, and budget signals for each enabled capability, provider, model, and environment.
requiredEvidence: admin dashboard or approved query reference
blockingConditions: provider failures, quota rejection, or budget exhaustion are not visible
an alert includes prompts, receipt content, OCR text, provider payloads, PII, or financial values
monitoring is accessible outside the authenticated admin role
an enabled provider has no disable or escalation trigger

checks.requirement: A privacy-safe troubleshooting runbook identifies symptoms, safe correlation fields, retry guidance, provider disablement, escalation, deletion requests, and user communication.
blockingConditions: support requires raw prompts, provider responses, receipt content, or OCR text
provider disablement or escalation steps are missing or untested
a deletion or privacy incident has no accountable escalation path
user guidance can cause duplicate submission or financial confirmation

checks.requirement: The final release record binds every decision and approval to one release commit, environment, capability, provider, and model immediately before publication.
blockingConditions: any required check is blocked or lacks evidence
a not-applicable decision lacks scope, rationale, approver, date, and compensating controls
evidence refers to a different commit, environment, provider, model, or capability
configuration changed after approval without rerunning affected checks
